title: 1권 8유닛 장면 · 1
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble). Scene: Sunrise over the second garden: a big smiling yellow sun rises above the wall and the sky turns orange and gold. On the garden path a grey seal balancing a glowing golden seed on its nose races a green turtle with a patterned shell; Bun waves a leaf like a flag at the finish line, Hedgie cheers, Pip flutters above the racers. Hidden in the picture: the sun, the seal, the turtle. On his small hill in the background, Grumble puffs his cheeks and blows out his candle lantern — a little curl of smoke rises from it and the lantern is dark. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
